about: Curated entry points into public access / community television held at the Internet Archive. Each preset is an Internet Archive advanced-search query (Lucene syntax). Edit freely; the site reloads this file on every visit.

regions.name: North America
regions.blurb: The birthplace of cable public access. Franchise agreements from the 1970s onward obliged cable operators to hand channels to the public, and thousands of hours survive in the Community Media Archive.
